filename: An improved methodology for estimating Kinetic Energy transfers from structure functions with regularized least-squares ABSTRACT.pdf
title: An improved methodology for estimating Kinetic Energy transfers from structure functions with regularized least-squares
testbed_rationale: Conference abstract describing an inverse/regularized least-squares formulation without provided code, benchmark datasets, or data access links.
pain_points: Sparse velocity observations make cross-scale kinetic energy transfer estimation difficult
Existing non-negative least squares (NNLS) assume monotonic transfers, failing to capture convergences or negative energy injections
extraction_notes: Abstract PS44C-1580 from Ocean Sciences Meeting (scheduled February 2026). RLS is applied as an inverse estimation/regularization method rather than deep learning.
